renderDrawer() replaces its children. Preserve a serializable semantic locator for the exact saved revision and Historical review action, then focus the recreated control on parent return. Use “No changes were made” only for a failure before writing. A confirmed removal may be followed by a failed list read, so the general unavailable-list message must remain neutral. Already-absent removal: “This snapshot is no longer saved on this device.” Unconfirmed write: “The change couldn’t be confirmed. Check Saved snapshots before trying again.” Do not call an unreadable collection empty. Legacy state 14 keeps its original case and missing-digest explanation.

Initial 76 passed / 3 failed and later 3 passed receipts are preserved; no single-run 79-pass claim. Eight final native dialog crops were inspected.

Still required next: 30-day saved item from a 7-day view → review → parent → Close back to 7 days; detached saved-item parent and truly detached review; native Back/Forward; same-revision disclosure, scroll, semantic focus and locale continuity; missing record during return; visible-opener fallback. At 320px and 390px, verify target sizes and reduced motion. Locale changes must create no history entry or storage write. Dialog crops alone do not prove desktop full-viewport toast placement.
